video_compose.description: Accepts an operation envelope (default compose), direct Remotion props with nonempty cuts, or a scene plan with nonempty scenes. Direct cuts take precedence over scenes and operation. Direct Explainer props support width, height, fps and duration_seconds; defaults are 1920x1080 at 30 fps, with one second padding after the last cut only when duration_seconds is omitted. Metadata validation runs in Remotion, not in estimates; estimates do not deeply validate props or prove a render will succeed.

duration_seconds.description: Direct Explainer props: exact duration; duration_seconds * fps must be a positive safe integer frame count. Cuts must fit within it and span at least one frame after boundary rounding. Omit for last cut out_seconds + 1 second (60 seconds with no cuts in Remotion).

fps.description: Direct Explainer props: positive finite frame rate, used for metadata and scene timing.

height.description: Direct Explainer props: positive even safe integer pixels.

width.description: Direct Explainer props: positive even safe integer pixels.

final_review.description: Structured self-review of the rendered output. The compose stage must produce this artifact to prove the agent inspected the actual rendered video before presenting it to the user. If status is 'revise' or 'fail', the agent must not present the video as complete.

promise_preservation.description: Delivery promise and renderer governance checks

runtime_swap_detected.description: True if the runtime that ran differs from the runtime locked in proposal_packet. An unapproved swap is a contract violation.

transcript_comparison.description: Optional: transcribe the output and compare to source script

status.description: pass=ready to present, revise=fixable issues found, fail=critical problems

grounded_in.description: Which research_brief findings support this concept

alternative_paths.description: Alternative production paths at different price/quality points

art_direction.description: Required when composition_mode='atelier'. Short note (or path to art-direction.md) committing to a fresh visual language for THIS piece — palette, type, motion, signature device. Per skills/meta/bespoke-composition.md step 1, written down BEFORE authoring scenes.

composition_mode.description: Locked at proposal — HOW the composition is built (orthogonal to render_runtime). templated=assemble stock cut.type scenes (Explainer/CinematicRenderer); atelier=hand-author a project-local composition from scratch with no creative-component reuse. Default atelier for hero work. See AGENT_GUIDE.md → 'Composition Authoring Mode' and skills/meta/bespoke-composition.md. The decision MUST be logged in decision_log with category='composition_mode' and BOTH options presented.
